EVERYTHING ELSE IN THIS BLOCK VERIFIED CORRECT and should not be re-flagged: the antipode identity reduces to 1/q^5 = q^-4(1/q) as stated; the O(w) coefficients -2, -1, -2 are right; Extension 1's surrogate closed form is EXACT -- (q^2*chi_(3) + q*chi_(2,1) + 1*chi_(1,1,1))/((1+q)(1+q+q^2)) simplifies identically to the displayed degree-11/degree-7 quotient (and the reversed assignment (1,q,q^2) does NOT, so the block's ordering is the right one); Extension 2's quotient-rule arithmetic N'(1) = -10, D(1) = 12, N(1) = 0 => -5/6 is right; Extension 5's recursion 4(n+1)a_(n+1) + 6n a_n + (2n-1)a_(n-1) = 0 with a_0 = 1/2, a_1 = 0 was checked against the actual Taylor coefficients of z(q) = sqrt(q)/(1+q) at q=1, a = (1/2, 0, -1/16, 1/16, -13/256, 5/128, -61/2048, 47/2048), and holds exactly for n = 1..6.
